summary: Nether and warped wart blocks do not come after leaves in the Creative inventory
description:
For a comprehensive list of other examples of issues with item positions in the Creative inventory, click here.

All tickets associated with item placement in the Creative inventory are valid for cases introduced in 1.16 and later as per this comment. Exceptions exist, which are valid for their own reasons.

## The bug

From a functional standpoint, wart blocks are to fungi what leaves are to trees. As a result, it would be expected they would come directly after leaves in Creative, however this does not happen.

Leaves should probably be moved to Building Blocks in the process.

## How to reproduce

 - Open the Creative inventory

 - Locate Nether Wart Block in Building Blocks

 - Locate Warped Wart Block in Building Blocks

 - Locate leaves in Decoration Blocks

 - Note that these items do not even occur in the same tab
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Enter the world and open the Creative inventory.
4. Open the Building Blocks tab and locate Nether Wart Block.
5. Locate Warped Wart Block in the Building Blocks tab.
6. Open the Decoration Blocks tab and locate the leaves.
7. Observe that Nether Wart Block and Warped Wart Block are not placed directly after the leaves and that these items do not occur in the same tab.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 20w18a, 20w20a, 20w21a, 1.16 Pre-release 2, 1.16 Pre-release 3, 1.16 Pre-release 5, 20w28a, 20w29a, 20w30a, 1.16.2 Pre-release 1, 1.16.2 Pre-release 3, 1.16.2 Release Candidate 1, 1.16.2, 1.16.3 Release Candidate 1, 1.16.3, 1.16.4, 20w48a, 20w51a, 21w03a, 21w05b, 21w06a, 1.17, 1.17.1, 1.18, 1.18.1, 1.18.2, 22w13a, 22w15a, 1.19, 1.19.2 (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior:
## Actual behavior

In the Creative inventory, **Nether Wart Block** and **Warped Wart Block** are listed in the **Building Blocks** tab, while the leaf blocks are listed in the **Decoration Blocks** tab. Because these blocks are separated into different tabs, the wart blocks do not appear after the leaf blocks in the Creative inventory.
Expected Behavior: Nether Wart Block and Warped Wart Block should appear in the same Creative inventory tab as leaves, with the wart blocks placed directly after the leaves in the item order. Leaves should be moved to the Building Blocks tab so these functionally related blocks are grouped together and can be found consecutively.
